name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM insurgency persists across Mali and Burkina Faso; no blockade or fall of a capital
state: Militant Islamist violence in the Sahel remains at high levels, with the Africa Center reporting mounting fatalities and shifting tactics across Mali and Burkina Faso. JNIM and Tuareg rebels launched coordinated attacks in Mali in April, killing the defence minister, but searches on 6 Nov found no current blockade or fall of a capital or major city, and no spread of mass-casualty attacks to coastal states (Crisis Group).
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.
rubric_hit: Watch: sustained insurgency; no capital blockade or spread to coastal states

sources.title: Africa Center for Strategic Studies — Mounting fatalities linked to militant Islamist violence in Africa
Crisis Group — Major jihadist attack exposes military failings in Burkina Faso

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.

rubric.alert: Blockade or fall of a capital or major city, or mass-casualty attacks spreading to coastal states.
